parole.significato: A kind of Southeast Asian curry steamed in banana leaves native to Cambodia.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Khmer អាម៉ុក (ʼaamok, “to steam in banana leaves”).

parole.significato: a gated community
parole.testo: From Khmer បុរី (borəy).

parole.significato: A subdivision of currency, equal to one tenth of a Cambodian riel.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Khmer កាក់ (kak). Doublet of jiao.

parole.significato: A landing, a port; a river town.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Khmer កំពង់ (kɑmpŭəng, “landing, port; river town; waterfront”).

parole.significato: A member of an ethnolinguistic group that constitutes most of the population of Cambodia.
parole.testo: From the French romanization of Khmer ខ្មែរ (khmae).

parole.significato: A commune of Cambodia, a subdivision of a srok.
parole.testo: From Khmer ឃុំ (khum).

parole.significato: A wild, forest-dwelling ox, Bos sauveli, from Cambodia and surrounding countries.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Khmer គោព្រៃ (koo prɨy).

parole.significato: A traditional Cambodian garment with many uses, including as a scarf or bandana or to carry children.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Khmer ក្រមា (krɑɑmaa).

parole.significato: Any of various pastes of herbs and spices used as a base for many Khmer dishes.
parole.testo: From Khmer គ្រឿង (krɨəng).

parole.significato: an improvised rail vehicle from Cambodia; a bamboo train.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Khmer ណូរី (nourii).

parole.significato: A salted and fermented fish paste used in Cambodian cuisine.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Khmer ប្រហុក (prɑɑhok).

parole.significato: A type of tower or spire featured in some Buddhist temples of Cambodia and Thailand.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Khmer ប្រាង្គ (praang).

parole.significato: The monetary unit of Cambodia, equivalent to 100 sen or 10 kak. Symbol: ៛
parole.testo: Borrowed from Khmer រៀល (riəl).

parole.significato: Any of several types of xylophone used in traditional Cambodian music.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Khmer រនាត (rɔɔrɔniət).

parole.significato: A Cambodian metallophone.
parole.testo: From Khmer រនាតដែក (rɔɔrɔniət daek).

parole.significato: A low-pitched xylophone used in the Khmer classical music of Cambodia.
parole.testo: From Khmer រនាតធុង (rɔɔrɔniət thung).

parole.significato: A type of double-headed barrel drum used in Cambodia.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Khmer សំភោរ (sɑmphoo).

parole.significato: The political ideology of Norodom Sihanouk
parole.testo: From Sihanouk + -ism. From Khmer សីហនុ (səyhnuʼ, “Seih-nou”), a Khmer given name. Named after Cambodian monarch Norodom Sihanouk (1922–2012).

parole.significato: Relating to Sihanoukism
parole.testo: From Sihanouk + -ist. From Khmer សីហនុ (səyhnuʼ, “Seih-nou”), a Khmer given name. Named after Cambodian monarch Norodom Sihanouk (1922–2012).

parole.significato: An ox horn or water buffalo horn used by the Khmer people as a musical instrument. It has been used to call for assembl…
parole.testo: Borrowed from Khmer ស្នែង (snaeng, “horn (of an animal)”), from Old Khmer sneṅ (“horn”).

parole.significato: A Cambodian wind instrument that uses a quadruple reed to produce sound.
parole.testo: From Khmer ស្រឡៃ (srɑɑlay).

parole.significato: A type of spike fiddle made from traditionally used in Cambodia and played vertically.
parole.testo: From Khmer ទ្រ (trɔɔ).
